note: The idea registry has FOUR independent guards in cli/tests/docs_consistency.rs and I tripped three of them in series. (1) Idea cell caps at 600 chars, and the waiver file is append-NEVER so you cannot buy your way out. (2) Status must be one of exactly six literals: raw, elaborated, spec-quote-d, shipped, ratified, rejected. Inventing a plausible one like ratified-in-spec fails. (3) Rows must have exactly five columns, and a bare pipe inside a code snippet in your prose silently makes it seven, which ALSO shifts every column-indexed edit you then make onto the wrong cell. Escape it. (4) The non-obvious one: a GitHub blob URL in the Where cell is validated against the LOCAL path, so you cannot cite a retrospective or chronicle your campaign has not written yet. Point Where at the spec and re-point it when the later doc lands. Corollary for scripted edits: check every cell length and status BEFORE writing the file, not one row at a time inside the loop, or you get a partial write and a confusing second failure.
